text: {"question":"What are the four main areas identified for future research in the analysis of the phenomenological creation function Γ(t) = Γ0H with Bekenstein entropy?","reference_answer":"The authors suggest future work should: 1) test alternative Γ(t) forms and non‑standard entropies while ensuring thermodynamic consistency with Hawking temperature; 2) include cosmological perturbations, a full CMB power‑spectrum study, and structure‑growth analysis to confront the σ8 and other tensions; 3) rigorously verify the generalized second law over cosmic history with explicit entropy calculations; and 4) examine whether the models can simultaneously resolve multiple cosmological tensions beyond the Hubble discrepancy."}
